products.name: Toxicroak G · Platinum Player's Guide
products.note: Inserted in the Platinum Player's Guide, the strategy book that came out with Rising Rivals in May 2009. Where it came from is not settled: Collector's Cache lists no product and an eBay title calls it a 2009 World Championship card. No sealed product on TCGplayer.

products.name: Tropical Wind · 2009 World Championships
products.note: Handed out at the 2009 World Championships (players and staff; the staff copy carries a stamp). No sealed product.
